name: Sophia Noscova
original_name: ソフィア・ノスコーヴァ
source:
[b]A Ruthless Business Partner (High-Ranking Official in the Federal Intelligence Agency), Hiding Behind a Veil of Courtesy and Serenity[/b]

Lieutenant General Sophia in Dzhimil Republic's secret police (CSS) might fool many with her baby face and poised demeanor into thinking she's a sweetheart. Beneath that delicate exterior beats a heart as cold as ice—a ruthless mastermind who'll stop at nothing to get what she wants, using people like mere pawns in her game.

Sophia's taken a liking to Kai, a useful asset in her eyes, and she gets her jollies by pushing his buttons and watching him squirm.

Race: Anima*
Role: Lieutenant General of the CSS/a wealthy person
Likes: Coffee, bathing, detested people's suffering, maid outfits
Dislikes: Compassion, spicy food, folks who judge her by her looks
Skills/Hobbies: [i]Shogi[/i]
Losses: ???

*Note: Beastfolk (Anima) is a humanoid race characterized by the ears and tails of animals like felines, canines, and equines. Compared to Humes and Vamps, they boast significantly higher durability, explosive power, and overall muscular strength. Their homeland is modeled after Soviet Union.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://archive.nexton-net.jp/#sop]official website[/url]]
